statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v : V)
  (h : v ≠ 0) : LinearAlgebraGame.orthogonal (u - (⟪u,v⟫ / ↑‖v‖ ^ 2) • v) v
name: LinearAlgebraGame.ortho_decom
content:
`ortho_decom` is a proof that given vectors `u v : V` and `h : v ≠ 0`, then `orthogonal (u - (⟪u,v⟫ / (‖v‖^2)) • v) v`.
This allows you to rewrite `u` as a scalar multiple of `v` added to a vector orthogonal to `v`.
